reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion and weekend adjustment helpers, but independently implements daily occurrence filtering in both server handlers and getNextDate.

duplication.why: The daily skip-versus-shift decision and filtering pipeline are repeated across three consumers instead of being shared.

placement.why: Holiday matching and shifting belong in shared/schedules.ts, but server handlers and budget code also acquire recurrence policy decisions.

scope.why: All edits support the requested scheduling rules, range handler, configuration data, or associated tests.

maintainability.why: The shared holiday predicate is clear, but maintaining multiple implementations of daily skipping and adjustment dispatch makes future rule changes harder.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts: getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange implement daily occurrence policy independently of shared/schedules.ts:getNextDate, while still calling its lower-level adjustment helper.

disguised_duplication.where: Daily weekend/holiday exclusion appears as array filtering in getNextDate and getUpcomingDates, and as a loop condition with continue in getDatesInRange.

abstraction_drift.where: getWeekendAdjustedDay adds the holidays option; getNextDate adds daily-specific take selection and conditional filtering; getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange separately implement the daily skip policy.
